method.description: Community Coleman/Tiger Growth-style framework; not recovered personal investor algorithm
native_method_steps: Define product, customer, and growth engine
Estimate growth duration and competitive moat
Compare valuation to multi-year compounding path
method.card_note: This Coleman Skill has no card-selection contract.
method.verdict_rationale: Scalable profitable core and plausible runway warrant attention. Incomplete marginal investment/retention evidence and a reference return below the analyst hurdle do not support concentrated sizing.

filters.unitEconomicsPositiveOrImproving: positive aggregate FoA operating economics, but margin not improving and advertiser cohort economics unresolved
filters.growthDurationCredible: plausible but conditional; core AI mechanism reinforced by E1, future cost/ROI uncertain
filters.brokenRetention: not established; missing cohorts do not prove broken retention
filters.noPathToProfit: not established; current substantial FoA and group operating profit
filters.riskDefined: major thesis and balance-sheet risks described; personal portfolio risk constraints not supplied

fact_provenance.value: Capex dollar growth expected notably larger than 2025; total expense percentage growth expected significantly faster than 2025. No numerical 2026 budget supplied.

source_limitations.note: Company FCF is a cash-flow measure after cash PPE and lease principal. It is not audited FCFF or Buffett owner earnings. Maintenance/growth capex split, sustainable tax rate, operating working-capital conventions, interest adjustments, future SBC/dilution treatment and discount rate are not supplied. Missing does not mean zero. This is no gate on useful qualitative analysis or a labeled scenario.
Use Sept 30 cash/debt observation plus separately dated November financing. Do not present Sept cash minus debt as Dec net cash; Q4 cash uses and cash generation are unknown here.

No SaaS subscription NDR, logo churn, CAC payback or customer-level LTV is invented. Advertiser retention/cohort data are not disclosed in this packet. DAP growth and ARPP are aggregate engagement/monetization, not retention.

2,572m Q3 weighted-average diluted shares are a scenario denominator, not actual shares outstanding. 2,520,527,597 Oct 24 actual A+B shares are an earlier capitalisation proxy. Do not combine A-only shares with group earnings.
This research was retrieved in 2026 from source-dated pre-cutoff documents. It does not claim preservation of a 2025 browse session. Later search results were screened out.
SBC is included in GAAP costs and added back in CFO. Method must separately choose and disclose dilution or economic-cost treatment, avoiding an automatic double penalty.
Cash finance-lease principal is included. Bond debt excludes lease liabilities. No claim of complete all-in enterprise value or complete economic net debt.

assumptions.description: Mandated partial adjusted-earnings proxy; only disclosed tax charge and useful-life effect adjusted.
2,572m stale Q3 diluted weighted-average share proxy, not December count or reported TTM denominator.
Four supplied annual total-NI growth / year-five P/E pairs: 0%/15x, 8%/18x, 12%/22x, 16%/26x. Sensitivities, no probabilities.
Primary annual net share change zero; separate reference 1% dilution. SBC remains an earnings expense; repurchases not assumed free.
Analyst chooses 12% annual price-return hurdle; 22x reference exit P/E also analyst-supplied, not Coleman guidance.
No dividend credit in price-return calculations; does not deny existence of dividends.

gaps: Advertiser cohort retention/churn, causal conversion economics, advertiser CAC/LTV/payback; subscription NDR is not applicable.
Revenue/net profit attributable to incremental AI compute, frontier-model investment payback and future expense/depreciation path.
Maintenance versus growth capex, sustainable cash taxes and complete economic net debt.
December share count and balance sheet; November borrowing proceeds and Q4 cash spending/generation unresolved.
User portfolio constraints, existing holdings, liquidity needs and correlated risk exposure.

claim_handling.observed_fact_or_attributed_opinion: AI recommendations raised Facebook time spent 5%.
claim_handling.native_method_test: Steps 1 and 3: engagement-led growth and growth duration.
claim_handling.economic_mechanism: Better recommendation may increase useful attention and ad inventory; it does not establish marginal profit.
claim_handling.assumption_effect: Strengthens plausibility of a core-product growth mechanism; no change to default growth.
claim_handling.calibration_uncertainty: Management measurement and experiment definitions are not independently audited; monetization, cannibalization and incremental cost unknown.

claim_handling.observed_fact_or_attributed_opinion: AI recommendations raised Threads time spent 10%.
claim_handling.native_method_test: Steps 1 and 3: product engagement and runway.
claim_handling.economic_mechanism: A smaller product can deepen engagement, but group materiality and monetization are unmeasured.
claim_handling.assumption_effect: Adds qualitative runway evidence; not a 10% group revenue increment.
claim_handling.calibration_uncertainty: Base revenue share, duration and counterfactual unknown.

claim_handling.observed_fact_or_attributed_opinion: Lattice app-ad deployment produced nearly 3% conversion gain for that objective.
claim_handling.native_method_test: Step 2: advertiser economics and retention mechanism.
claim_handling.economic_mechanism: Improved objective conversion could raise advertiser ROI and bidding demand.
claim_handling.assumption_effect: Useful scoped indication of ad efficiency; no invented advertiser retention/CAC/LTV or total-platform gain.
claim_handling.calibration_uncertainty: Measurement method, causal incrementality, rollout coverage and net cost unavailable.

claim_handling.observed_fact_or_attributed_opinion: Automated ad tools handled USD60b annualized revenue run rate.
claim_handling.native_method_test: Steps 1 and 2: monetization and unit-economics scope.
claim_handling.economic_mechanism: Large existing-revenue exposure can make tool improvements relevant to the core business.
claim_handling.assumption_effect: Adoption scale is credited; incremental standalone AI revenue interpretation is rejected; no double counting in revenue/E0.
claim_handling.calibration_uncertainty: Revenue overlaps existing ads; margin and counterfactual incremental revenue unknown.

claim_handling.observed_fact_or_attributed_opinion: Management saw profitable core uses for additional compute and possible uses for surplus capacity, while acknowledging overshoot.
claim_handling.native_method_test: Steps 2 through 4: economic payback, duration and valuation path.
claim_handling.economic_mechanism: Core reuse could reduce stranded capacity, but frontier-model costs may outrun monetization.
claim_handling.assumption_effect: Retains both reuse and overspend hypotheses; no uplift to growth, margin or exit multiple.
claim_handling.calibration_uncertainty: No promised ROI, payback date or completed external compute business; total spend cannot be valued from scoped ad experiments.

claim_handling.observed_fact_or_attributed_opinion: Public article reports Jason Helfstein/Oppenheimer moved Outperform to Perform.
claim_handling.native_method_test: Step 4: examine premises rather than aggregate votes.
claim_handling.economic_mechanism: The published action establishes the author's stance, not economic value.
claim_handling.assumption_effect: Records provenance only; no verdict or parameter imported.
claim_handling.calibration_uncertainty: Full note and model unavailable; display timezone unspecified.

claim_handling.observed_fact_or_attributed_opinion: Unclear superintelligence revenue, possible cost offset to ads, metaverse-era analogy and poor 2027 visibility.
claim_handling.native_method_test: Steps 2 through 4: profit conversion, capital-allocation risk and duration.
claim_handling.economic_mechanism: Fast costs/depreciation can dilute a strong advertising engine; past project analogy is not causal proof.
claim_handling.assumption_effect: Cost-risk mechanism is material and supported by base spending direction; historical recurrence and loss probabilities remain unresolved.
claim_handling.calibration_uncertainty: No full forecast series, probabilities, measured frontier ROI or calibrated earnings haircut.

claim_handling.observed_fact_or_attributed_opinion: Article attributes an approximately 21x 2027 estimated-earnings comparison for Meta and Alphabet.
claim_handling.native_method_test: Step 4: independently compare valuation with compounding.
claim_handling.economic_mechanism: A peer multiple can be context only if dates and estimates are comparable.
claim_handling.assumption_effect: Not used as cutoff-price multiple, reference exit P/E or an independent valuation conclusion.
claim_handling.calibration_uncertainty: Forecast earnings, price dates and full model unavailable; cannot map to five-year exit multiple.

claim_handling.observed_fact_or_attributed_opinion: Author argues core dominance/revenue growth offset AI uncertainty and RL losses, making the selloff an opportunity.
claim_handling.native_method_test: All four steps: platform strength must connect to economics and paid price.
claim_handling.economic_mechanism: Existing platform strength supports runway, but shareholder returns also depend on spending and valuation.
claim_handling.assumption_effect: Healthy core growth is supported by base facts; dominance is qualitative, and bargain conclusion is not adopted.
claim_handling.calibration_uncertainty: No independently supplied share-of-market study or profit path sufficient to establish bargain value.

claim_handling.observed_fact_or_attributed_opinion: USD869 median analyst target and roughly 28% upside at the article's then-current price.
claim_handling.economic_mechanism: An unexplained target supplies no reliable earnings/return mechanism.
claim_handling.assumption_effect: No target, upside or numerical parameter imported; December USD660.09 basis retained.
claim_handling.calibration_uncertainty: Survey universe, collection time and model basis absent; percentage cannot migrate between price dates.

additional_materials.reason: No addition sufficiently calibrates a five-year earnings-growth or exit-multiple revision. Primary common grid remains unchanged.
additional_materials.qualitative_effect: Scoped core engagement/conversion observations strengthen mechanism confidence. Cost-offset and overshoot remain material. No unseen baseline comparison is claimed.
